content_of_post_to_answer: Does the quantization of Infinite Energy by “Mind” generate all of finite “SpaceTime”?
answer: The intriguing question here is whether “Mind” is being treated as a physical cause or as a conceptual framework for describing reality. Physics has shown that space and time are not fixed backgrounds but relationships that emerge from deeper structures, yet that does not automatically imply a conscious mind creates them. The subtle distinction is between a universe being dependent on information and being dependent on awareness. Confusing those two ideas can turn a profound question into an unfalsifiable claim.
